cause.deadline_owner: modules.telchi.datalake.sales_query.query_sales: asyncio.wait_for(process.communicate(), 30); SalesCapabilities default worker timeout is 30 seconds
cause.not_the_cause: SQL aggregation was 226.177 ms in the baseline; the observed deadline was consumed before business SQL. No evidence attributes the timeout to model inference, HANA or a global host metric.
cause.measured_bottleneck: Canonical manifest validation calls validate_transition -> append_proof -> typed Reference row comparison and version_content. The original comparison JSON-serialized and SHA256-hashed every normalized row. Baseline cProfile measured 736113 reference_update.digest calls and 8396580 typed-cell conversions; original projected comparison cumulative time 38.187 s under profiler.
cause.fix: Compare exact typed row multisets using Counter of tuples, retaining duplicate multiplicity, nulls, schema order, decimal and timezone normalization. Bound local timestamp/decimal memoization to 8192 entries per converter, per comparison. Published fingerprints, full Reference version_content identity, capture receipts, physical hashes, CURRENT and authorization checks remain unchanged.
secondary_conversational_defects: A real October interpretation proposed DIRECT_UNAVAILABLE despite a valid explicit daily cut and an available monetary capability. Clarified partial-period execution and inclusive day-cut semantics in Luna's prompt; no execution barrier was bypassed.

A later real September interpretation proposed /limit=null and failed the state-engine commit barrier. Clarified the existing non-null integer limit contract, safe resets and a minimal query example; backend rejection remains intact.
